text: Which dispenser would you choose? Pick fast... you only get three seconds!
Round one! Waffles with syrup... or fluffy pancakes?
Round two! Hot cheesy pizza... or juicy burgers?
Round three! Ice cream cones... or sprinkle donuts?
Round four! Crispy fries... or chicken nuggets?
Round five! Hot chocolate... or ice cold lemonade?
Round six! Warm cookies... or frosted cupcakes?
Final round! A dispenser that gives you gold coins... or one that gives you any food you want, forever?
Comment which ones you picked! Did you go A, or B?
